What will you do
Your main mission is simple: ensure all groceries are delivered neatly and on time! As a courier, you start your shift at the distribution centre. Once you've collected your truck and route list, you hit the road! You deliver the groceries right to the customer's front door. This definitely means you'll need to flex those muscles! 💪 All set? Then it's on to the next customer! 🚀

- Delivering Groceries
- Customer Interaction & Service
- Driving the Delivery Truck

Where will you work
You’ll be working for the most popular supermarket in the Netherlands! As a Courier for Albert Heijn Online, your shifts fall between 06:00 and 14:00 or between 13:00 and 23:00 (Monday through Saturday). We schedule your shifts within these times, making it easy to combine work with your hobbies! Plus, you'll definitely not be doing this job alone—you'll have plenty of great colleagues!
